lines.text: Previously. In Saint Lumen, the Golden Saint asked me to wear the gold. I said no.
I found Haruki. He does not want to come home. He is helping Lucien build a road there instead.
lines.tts: I found Hah-roo-kee. He does not want to come home. He is helping Lucien build a road there instead.

lines.text: The road costs light. Brands. The people who pay it go grey, and cold.
And I put a crack in a wall that nothing has ever broken.
Wake up, old friend. Six years is a long nap, even for a Calamity.
Your favourite Hunter is very close. The one who got away.
Saint! A rider from the plains. A horde, two days out. Thousands. Lesser Fiends, mostly.
And something at the back of them. Bigger than a hill.
Morvudd.
You are certain?
Nothing else walks behind a horde. Morvudd does not lead. It drives.
Then the Order holds the walls of Saint Lumen. My Sanctum covers the city. Nothing will pass it.
And the villages on the plains? There are six of them between here and the horde.
We will open the gates to anyone who reaches them.
They will not reach them. Not in two days. Not with children.
Then someone holds the plains road. At the old stone bridge. Long enough for the villages to run.
That someone will die, Sieg.
lines.tts: That someone will die, Seeg.

lines.text: Probably.
We go with him.
Haruki stays. The Rite needs him.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee stays. The Rite needs him.

lines.text: Lucien, I could freeze the front of the horde. Three seconds at a time. It would save...
You stay, Haruki. That is not a request.
lines.tts: You stay, Hah-roo-kee. That is not a request.

lines.text: ...Yes, Saint.
Not a request. Did you hear how fast his voice went cold, boy?
You asked me what consecrated means. I found out.
Where?
Down here. Under the cathedral. There are forty beds of crystal. Forty people asleep in them. Their Brands are gone.
Not grey. Gone. Like someone scraped the light out of them with a spoon.
Are they alive?
They breathe. That is all. I knew one of them. Mira, from Osaka. She taught me how to buy bread here. She was consecrated last spring.
lines.tts: They breathe. That is all. I knew one of them. Mira, from Oh-sah-kah. She taught me how to buy bread here. She was consecrated last spring.

lines.text: Lucien told me she went home.
...I am sorry, Haruki.
lines.tts: ...I am sorry, Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: Don't be sorry. Takuto says you say that. Be useful.
lines.tts: Don't be sorry. Tah-koo-toh says you say that. Be useful.

lines.text: He told you that?
He tells me everything you say. He pretends he doesn't. He is a bad liar.
What will you do?
I do not know yet. But I am not sitting in a golden chair. Ever.
Stay here, Takuto. With Haruki. You came all this way for him.
lines.tts: Stay here, Tah-koo-toh. With Hah-roo-kee. You came all this way for him.

lines.text: No.
You keep saying no to powerful people. It is a bad habit.
You are not a powerful person. You are Sieg.
lines.tts: You are not a powerful person. You are Seeg.

lines.text: Ha. That might be the nicest thing you have ever said to me.
Morvudd took eleven from me. If it takes you, I will not be able to count anymore. Do you understand?
If it takes you, I will have to start counting. I do not want to learn.
...Stubborn.
You taught me. Always the first move.
I taught you that for fighting, not for arguing with me.
It works for both.
Make way! Guild wagon from Ashford! Make way!
Darlings! We heard there was a Calamity. We simply could not miss it.
Valentine. Gideon. You came all the way from Ashford?
Twelve days in a wagon with Tofu. He sings. Did you know he sings? Nobody warned me he sings.
He sings beautifully.
He sings in error codes!
Boy. Arms out. I rewound your harness on the road. Double chains. Two blocks a day now.
Two?
Two. Spend the first one on yourself, for once. I insist. The second one, I know you will waste on somebody old.
...Thank you, Gideon.
Tofu. You came too.
He wanted to see Takuto. He has been practising reading errors all the way here.
lines.tts: He wanted to see Tah-koo-toh. He has been practising reading errors all the way here.

lines.text: Gideon! Takoyaki and Takoyaki say hello! Look, I only burn what I look at now!
Then stop looking at my hat.
Sieg. You look like a man walking to his own funeral.
lines.tts: Seeg. You look like a man walking to his own funeral.

lines.text: I am walking to Morvudd's. I would like you there.
...Then I will bring a very good dress. And my Encore.
And I will bring my letter.
Vesper.
The Guild sent me to watch you on the plains, error. If the axe goes red near a city of a hundred thousand people, I do my job.
Then watch.
...I intend to.
Keep moving! The Hunters are holding the bridge! Keep moving!
Mama, are the monsters coming?
Thank you, Hunters! Gods keep you!
Bye, Mister Hunters!
There are so many of them. Carts and cows and grandmas. They are never going to make it in time.
They will, if we stand here long enough.
How long is long enough?
Until we cannot stand.
...I hate that answer. It is the right answer. I hate it.
Grandma! Grandma, I will carry you! I am rank F, I am very strong!
Your head is on fire, young man.
It is very warm. Carry on.
Children. This way. Hold the tail. Everybody hold the tail. Do not let go.
Valentine, the bridge rails. Iron. If I wake them, they will hold for an hour.
And I will put on a show for the front row. Sieg, darling, how long do you need?
lines.tts: And I will put on a show for the front row. Seeg, darling, how long do you need?

lines.text: Until the last cart is over the hill.
Then it will be a long show. I adore long shows.
Sieg. The bridge is narrow. Twenty paces. They can only come at us five at a time.
lines.tts: Seeg. The bridge is narrow. Twenty paces. They can only come at us five at a time.

lines.text: Good eye. Five at a time is a conversation. Five hundred at a time is a funeral.
And Morvudd?
Morvudd does not use bridges. Morvudd is what the river is afraid of.
Sieg. You promised. At Grey Hollow, your squad asked for the one about the bear and the bishop. Tell it. Please.
lines.tts: Seeg. You promised. At Grey Hollow, your squad asked for the one about the bear and the bishop. Tell it. Please.

lines.text: You want the bear and the bishop? Tonight?
Tonight is the best night for it. Tomorrow we might be dead and never hear the ending.
Nemu!
lines.tts: Neh-moo!

lines.text: It is true!
...Ha. Fine. A bear walks into a cathedral, and asks the bishop for a blessing.
The bishop says, my son, the church does not bless bears. The bear says, that is fine, I will wait.
Forty years later, the bishop is dying. And the bear is still there. Still waiting.
So the bishop sighs, and blesses the bear. And the bear says, thank you. Now I can eat you. I have been very hungry.
...That is a terrible joke.
Yes. Mara used to say so every time. Then she would laugh until she cried.
Ha. Ha ha. Patience is a very scary bear.
Ha... that is so stupid. Why am I laughing?
Because it is stupid.
That is the whole secret of it. You laugh because tomorrow does not care. Thank you. All of you. I have not told it in six years.
A bear and a bishop. You still tell it wrong, Valen.
The WOLF! Swords! Everybody, swords!
Sheathe them. I did not come for you.
Then why?
Morvudd ate my pack's mother when I was a pup. Sable fed her to it, to make me hungry. I only learned that last week.
I have my own debts on that bridge tomorrow.
And after?
After, we finish our duel. If either of us is still standing.
...After, then.
Give me your wrist.
The thread?
No. This. A strip of the scarf. Kaito's scarf. I cut it last night.
Rin. You said it stays the way he wore it.
He would have wanted a piece of it on the bridge. He liked bridges. He liked last stands. He was a show-off.
If the thread snaps tomorrow, the scarf still holds. Then you still have something to pull on.
...I will give it back.
You had better. With you still attached.
You did not sleep.
Neither did you.
Wolves do not sleep before a hunt. We listen to the ground.
And what does the ground say?
That something very heavy is walking toward us, and that it is hungry, and that it remembers you.
It should. I put a scar on it too, six years ago. Right before it put eleven on me.
Then today we give it more scars than it can count.
Careful, Kurozane. You almost sound like a friend.
Do not insult me before breakfast, Valen.
Two lives, Takuto.
lines.tts: Two lives, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: I know.
If I use one today, do not be sad. It is what they are for. They are not for keeping in a jar.
You are not using one today.
Mm. I will try very hard. I am lazy. Dying is a lot of work.
...Stay near Wick. He is warm.
He is very warm. Okay.
Here they come. The whole horizon is moving.
Five at a time. Remember. Five at a time.
Afterimage! First five!
Break!
Fang Draw!
Red Thread, tie the front ones to the river!
Fire head! Only Fiends! Only... there are SO MANY Fiends!
Will-o'-Wisp! The whole front row!
They are climbing the rails!
Frozen Hour!
Haruki?!
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee?!

lines.text: Lucien said stay. I have stayed for two years. Today I am not staying.
...About time.
Three seconds! Go!
Break, break, break!
Encore! Ladies and gentlemen, the front row!
Again! And again! You will dance this step forever, darlings!
Cogwheel Core! Every rail on this bridge, wake up and HOLD!
Chains! Bind them to the stones!
White Gale. The flank is mine.
There. Behind them.
Morvudd.
Hello again. You got bigger.
Everyone off the bridge. All of you. Get to the villagers. That is an order.
Sieg!
lines.tts: Seeg!

lines.text: Five at a time, Takuto. This one is my five. GO!
lines.tts: Five at a time, Tah-koo-toh. This one is my five. GO!

lines.text: Mara! Joss!
Pell! Bram! Bren!
...Hask. Tova.
Corin! Dace!
Ilse. Wen.
...Twelve. Nemu. Thirteen. Wick.
lines.tts: ...Twelve. Neh-moo. Thirteen. Wick.

lines.text: Fourteen. Rin. Fifteen... Takuto.
lines.tts: Fourteen. Rin. Fifteen... Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: Sieg is on the bridge alone. I have to...
lines.tts: Seeg is on the bridge alone. I have to...

lines.text: Why is everything stopped? The rain is stopped.
Hello, Takuto. Finally. I have so wanted to say hello properly.
lines.tts: Hello, Tah-koo-toh. Finally. I have so wanted to say hello properly.

lines.text: Sable.
Mister Sable, please. We are going to be close, you and I. Closer than you know.
What did you do to the rain?
Nothing. I simply stepped between two seconds. It is very quiet here. A good place to talk.
I want you to know something before your teacher dies. I am the one who brought you here.
The crossing. Two fourteen in the morning. The cat. I opened that Rift. I chose you.
Why me?
Because a key needs a hand. The thing in your axe is sealed with a lock that only Ruinbreaker can open. And Ruinbreaker only wakes in someone who would break the world to save one person.
Haruki.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: Bait. Very sweet bait. I took him first, two years ago, so that you would come looking. And you came. Everyone always comes.
Boy. BOY. Let me out. Let me at him. I have waited three hundred years to put my hands on that grin.
Not yet.
Not yet? Oh, I love that. Not yet. That is what everyone says, right before.
Go on. Your teacher is counting. He is nearly at fifteen.
Get away from him.
Yes. YES. Open it. All the way this time. He killed your teacher. He took your friend.
He... he...
Takuto.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: That is enough. They get it.
...Haruki.
lines.tts: ...Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: You put my hand there. Remember? If I was wrong about him, I would do it again.
I was wrong about him. So. Here is my hand.
And here is my thread.
And here is me shouting. TAKUTO.
...I hear you. All of you.
Akuro. Not today.
lines.tts: Ah-koo-roh. Not today.

lines.text: ...Hmph. You have too many friends, boy. It is very inconvenient.
Frozen Hour! Three seconds!
Afterimage...! One more... for the road...
Ruinbreaker!
They held! The Hunters held the bridge!
Every village made it! Every one!
...Fifteen. Sixteen. Haruki.
lines.tts: ...Fifteen. Sixteen. Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: You are alive.
I am counting. That means yes. Ow. Do not make me laugh. Ow.
Four broken ribs, a broken arm, and something wrong with your leg that I do not want to name. I am stitching all of it.
This stupid family.
This stupid family.
We fought a Calamity. Rank F. Rank F, Takuto! Somebody tell the clerk!
lines.tts: We fought a Calamity. Rank F. Rank F, Tah-koo-toh! Somebody tell the clerk!

lines.text: Error.
Vesper.
Your axe went red. Then it went out. With a city behind you, and a Calamity in front of you.
I will write that in my letter. In those words. They may not believe me.
Thank you.
Do not thank me. Keep doing it. Every letter I write about you, I would like to be boring.
Sieg. You stubborn, magnificent idiot. Do you know how much I cried? Allergies. Entirely allergies.
lines.tts: Seeg. You stubborn, magnificent idiot. Do you know how much I cried? Allergies. Entirely allergies.

lines.text: I wrote you a letter, at the pass. In case. It said not to cry.
Then I will cry twice as hard when I read it.
Valen. Get well. I want you at your best when I kill you.
You keep saying that. One day I will start to believe you.
...Ha. That laugh. Still hate it.
Takuto. You came back for me. On the bridge. I gave you an order.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. You came back for me. On the bridge. I gave you an order.

lines.text: You gave me a bad order.
...Ha. Ow. Yes. It was a terrible order. I have given a lot of terrible orders. Nobody ever ignored one before.
I counted you all, at the end. Did you know? Fifteen. Sixteen. I made it to sixteen. Eleven of them were already gone.
Five of them were standing over me when I woke up. That has never happened to me before.
Get used to it.
...I will try. It is harder than Morvudd.
Sable told you. Didn't he? That he took me first.
You knew?
I saw him. In Lucien's study. Three times this year. I told myself he was a diplomat. A merchant. Anything.
Lucien caught me with gold when I fell. I never asked who pushed.
Lucien is working with him.
I do not know. I do not know what is true anymore, Takuto. Except the bridge. The bridge was true.
lines.tts: I do not know. I do not know what is true anymore, Tah-koo-toh. Except the bridge. The bridge was true.

lines.text: Then come with us. Not back to Lumen.
I have to go back. The people in the Rite Hall. The grey hands. If I leave, nobody in there knows the truth.
...Then I go back with you.
Of course you do. You never wait to be asked.
Morvudd is dead. Valen lives. The Calamity stayed in the axe. And Haruki disobeyed me. Your plan failed, Sable.
lines.tts: Morvudd is dead. Valen lives. The Calamity stayed in the axe. And Hah-roo-kee disobeyed me. Your plan failed, Sable.

lines.text: Failed? Morvudd was never meant to win. Morvudd was meant to make him angry. And look how angry he is.
Besides. Tyr is awake. And Tyr is walking toward your city.
Next time: Tyr, the Frost Titan, comes to Saint Lumen.
To save the city, I open the door all the way. I become the Crimson Calamity.
Vesper is ordered to kill me. And Nemu spends her eighth life.
lines.tts: Vesper is ordered to kill me. And Neh-moo spends her eighth life.

lines.text: Episode eleven. Calamity.
